description: A pulse sequencer that also directs other sequencers. Each scene holds a count of pulses, and the settings are stored as numbered scenes

params.text: Switches the sequencing on and off
Makes the sequence start again from the beginning when it reaches the end
Adds one to the pulse count
Takes one off the pulse count
Puts the current scene's settings onto the panel
Stores the settings now on the panel as a new scene at the end
Writes the settings now on the panel over the current scene
Goes back to the first scene
Goes to the scene before the current one
Goes to the scene after the current one

inputs.text: A voltage switches the sequencing on and off
A pulse adds one to the pulse count
A pulse takes one off the pulse count
A pulse puts the current scene's settings onto the panel
A pulse stores the settings now on the panel as a new scene at the end
A pulse writes the settings now on the panel over the current scene
A pulse goes back to the first scene
A pulse goes to the scene before the current one
A pulse goes to the scene after the current one
A pulse deletes the current scene
A voltage switches recording on and off

outputs.text: A pulse when the last of the programmed pulses has gone
A pulse when the sequence reaches the end of its loop

notes: nothing is sequenced until scenes are stored: set a pulse count on the display and press ADD, once for each scene.
with the mouse over the module the number keys type a pulse count, and plus and minus step that count by one
with the mouse over the module, keypad Enter adds a scene at the end, Return updates the current scene and I inserts one before it
with the mouse over the module, Page Up and Page Down move between scenes and Escape drops the edits to the current scene
menu: Auto Deactivate on End of Loop — switches the sequencing off when the last scene of the loop finishes, giving a single pass
